svg.aria-label: Wentworth grain-size scale with sorting and maturity sketches, and four sedimentary structures in cross-section with way-up and current arrows
svg.text: (a) Grain size, sorting and maturity: texture records the transport history
(b) Four structures: each one gives palaeocurrent, way-up, or environment
Grey arrow = stratigraphic up (younger). Blue arrow = water motion.
the bed dried in open air.
